bannerText: Muse X Poster: bài đã điền sẵn (đã bỏ tag Binance). Bấm Post trên X để đăng, rồi báo Muse là xong.
note: Muse X Poster v1.7: WATCHDOG FIX FOR THE PAUSE/RESUME BUG (user 2026-11-16 ~13:46). v1.6 only re-enabled the paused extension when the content script reported back, but after clicking Post X often navigates to the new post page and destroys the content script before X_POSTED can be sent, so the other extension stayed disabled and the job lock stalled later polls. v1.7: the content script writes a postClicked milestone to storage the moment it clicks Post; the background creates a 5-minute watchdog alarm when a job starts, and if no outcome arrives it ALWAYS resumes the paused extension, marks the job done when the milestone says it was clicked (never post twice), or counts a failed attempt and releases the lock otherwise. A manual Resume paused extension button in the popup covers a stuck state left by v1.6. v1.6 pause behavior and v1.5 paste-based fill are unchanged.
